_note: AiContextSchema (packages/spec/src/ai/ai-context.zod.ts) — a context pack, the stack's `aiContexts` (ADR-0160 D1). Seeded 2026-11-25 with the type itself (#37140): every key is read by the one executor of `get_record_context` (`@objectstack/service-record-context`), which the MCP door registers over HTTP and stdio.
